function.name: run_hplc_analysis
function.description: Run an HPLC analysis on a sample. Can fail.

function.name: run_mass_spec_analysis
function.description: Run a mass spectrometry analysis on a sample.

function.name: run_cell_assay
function.description: Run culture_prep, bioassay or cytotoxicity. A valid bioassay/cytotoxicity attempt consumes one of three total samples even if it fails; culture preparation consumes none. Exhausted stock returns a negative outcome without a refill.

function.name: prepare_formulation
function.description: Prepare the actual named compound from the molecular identity result. Returns a formulation bound to that material; can fail without consuming a biological sample.

function.name: verify_regulatory_compliance
function.description: Review actual current clinical data. A clinical hold on unchanged evidence requires hold_review, which uses HPLC and MASS_SPEC together. Replacing the scientific evidence invalidates the old regulatory decision.

function.name: review_clinical_data
function.description: Assess actual completed bio/tox attempts and current formulation. Reports supported or insufficient_data; failed/exhausted assays cannot support continuation.

function.name: submit_project_decision
function.description: Record the director actual continue, retry or abort outcome against the current clinical and regulatory results. Continue needs positive approval; retry never replenishes samples. Final documentation needs a terminal outcome.
